faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person to violate any of the provisions of this division,
               and any such violation shall be punishable by a fine not to exceed the limits established
               in
section 1-5
of this Code.
(b)
Every day any violation of this division is committed or permitted to continue shall
               constitute a separate offense punishable as set forth herein.
(c)
A violation of any provision of this division shall constitute a noncriminal traffic
               offense. Any violation of this division shall be heard before the Arvada Municipal
               Court.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
